title: Brand kit in an hour
promise: Pick colors and fonts, draw a simple logo, and see it working on a real layout.
audience: New projects that need to look like one thing

steps.title: Choose a palette
steps.why: Coolors generates palettes you can lock and adjust, and shows how they look side by side.

steps.title: Choose fonts
steps.why: Google Fonts are free to use on the web, and a heading face plus a body face is all a small brand needs.

steps.title: Draw a simple logo
steps.why: Inkscape is a vector editor that exports SVG, so the logo stays sharp at any size. A wordmark in your chosen font is a perfectly good start.

steps.title: Try it on a real layout
steps.why: Figma's free tier is enough to drop the logo, colors and fonts onto a social header or a business card and see whether they hold together.
